origin.description: Draw n bootstrap resamples and label them.
origin.details: Each strap draws one row index per input row, with replacement. The draw is sample.int from the boot translation, so the same seed matches R. Ids are zero-padded to the width of n.
origin.value: A frame with a strap column and an id column.

translation.description: Draw n bootstrap resamples and label them.
translation.details: Each strap draws one row index per input row, with replacement. The draw is sample.int from the boot translation, so the same seed matches R. Ids are zero-padded to the width of n.
translation.value: A frame with a strap column and an id column.
translation.example:
set_seed(1)
print(" ".join(str(i) for i in bootstrap(mtcars, 3)["strap"][0].idx[:8]))
